description: This file provides support functions for camera capture sessions, including preparation of photo and movie sessions, error mapping, and session warm-up routines, specifically tailored for managing AVFoundation camera functionalities in an iOS app.

methods.name: preparePhotoSession
methods.description: Sets up an AVCaptureSession for taking photos, configuring input camera and photo output, and managing errors.

methods.name: prepareMovieSession
methods.description: Prepares an AVCaptureSession for recording movies, including optional audio input and output configuration, with error handling.

methods.name: prepareWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Asynchronously prepares and warms up a movie capture session, starting it and then awaiting session warm-up before returning.

methods.name: withWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous operation using a warmed-up movie session, ensuring the session stops after operation completion.

methods.name: mapMovieSetupError
methods.description: Maps setup errors related to camera/microphone configuration into a custom error type, differentiating microphone unavailability.

methods.name: makePhotoSettings
methods.description: Creates configured AVCapturePhotoSettings, prioritizing quality and JPEG format if available.

methods.name: capturePhotoData
methods.description: Captures photo data asynchronously using a delegate, returning raw photo data.

methods.name: warmUpCaptureSession
methods.description: Performs a brief sleep to reduce initial blank frames after starting a capture session.

methods.name: positionLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label ('front', 'back', or 'unspecified') for a given AVCaptureDevice.Position.
